name: Richy The Fly
description: Richy is a complete fruit-fly brain, 166,700 real neurons, wired to a wallet on Robinhood Chain. Nobody tells him what to buy. He smells the market, picks a coin, and his neurons decide. Every trade is on chain. When he wins, dopamine. When he loses, pain. He learns. 80% of RICHY trading fees fund his trading wallet; sell-side fees are burned.
